fields.name: timestamp
fields.description: Standardized ISO 8601 timestamp representing when the event occurred.
fields.justification: Allows analysts to accurately order events chronologically across mixed operating systems.

fields.name: hostname
fields.description: Name or identifier of the host machine where the event was logged.
fields.justification: Enables isolation of compromised assets during incident response triage.

fields.name: source_type
fields.description: Classification label indicating the original log format or ingestion pipeline source.
fields.justification: Allows parsing validation and traceability back to raw evidence files.

fields.name: event_category
fields.description: High-level grouping class describing the nature of the security event.
fields.justification: Needed by detection rules and triage filters to group events independently of source vendor.

fields.name: severity
fields.description: Calculated or logged importance level of the event indicating potential risk.
fields.justification: Helps analysts prioritize high-risk alerts over routine telemetry noise.

fields.name: user
fields.description: Account name associated with the execution or initiation of the event.
fields.justification: Tracks identity-based access patterns during credential-access investigations.

fields.name: process_name
fields.description: Name or filename of the executable file involved in the event action.
fields.justification: Identifies malicious process execution or binary abuse in endpoint logs.

fields.name: src_ip
fields.description: Originating IPv4 or IPv6 address for network or connection events.
fields.justification: Tracks external connections and lateral movement source endpoints.

fields.name: dst_ip
fields.description: Destination IPv4 or IPv6 address for network communications or traffic.
fields.justification: Identifies target servers or external command-and-control infrastructure.

fields.name: raw_message
fields.description: Complete original string line or log message prior to field extraction.
fields.justification: Preserves forensic authenticity and provides full context when parsed fields are ambiguous.
